title: ProgressIndicator
description: Fiori progress indicator: value bar with value text, value states with icons (ui5-progress-indicator).

usage.summary: Show a measured completion percentage for a running process.
useWhen: Help users track how much of a running process has completed when the amount is measurable.
Use value on a 0–100 scale and displayValue when a task-specific completion label is clearer than a percentage.

avoidWhen.when: Work is running but its completion percentage is unknown.
Show a business amount or quantity with a unit rather than process completion.
